_note: Demo fixture: pre-written round-one ideas for the Aquarium Park Dhaka demo. Round one uses only the confirmed profile (no performance knowledge).

ideas.title: Meet the aquarium zone
ideas.audience: Families in Dhaka who have not visited yet
ideas.objective: Introduce {business_name}'s aquarium zone to new families
ideas.hook: Colourful fish, right in the middle of Dhaka.
ideas.key_message: {business_name} brings aquatic life close to the city for a family day out.

ideas.title: Five species you can meet
ideas.audience: Parents and teachers looking for learning outings
ideas.objective: Share simple species facts that make a visit educational
ideas.key_message: Every zone at {business_name} is a chance to learn something new.

ideas.title: Which zone would your kids visit first?
ideas.audience: Followers who already know the park
ideas.objective: Start a conversation in the comments
ideas.hook: Aquarium, bird aviary or waterfall: which comes first?
ideas.key_message: Tell us which zone your family is most excited about.

ideas.title: Plan your weekend visit
ideas.key_message: Tickets, timings and what to bring for a relaxed family visit.

ideas.title: A 60-second walk through the park
ideas.objective: Show the full park experience in one minute
ideas.hook: From the entrance to the waterfall in 60 seconds.
ideas.key_message: There is more to see at {business_name} than you might expect.

ideas.title: Ticket types explained
ideas.audience: Families, students and military visitors comparing ticket options
ideas.objective: Make ticket choices clear before visiting
ideas.hook: Regular, student or military: which ticket is yours?
ideas.key_message: Choose the right entry ticket in a few seconds.
